What to look for: the dxc_trunk pane. Compiling this amplification shader crashes with
"cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!" (Linux CE builds omit the "llvm::" prefix that
Windows prints; both name the same DXC_E_LLVM_CAST_ERROR internal failure) as soon as the
whole-struct value `blah` is assigned into `payload.data`, a member of the groupshared
DispatchMesh payload. The dxc_1_6_2112 pane instead rejects the `as_6_7` profile outright
(amplification-shader profile support postdates that release), which is expected and not
part of the bug -- it is not evidence of a fix.
